concerns.text: US-1 acceptance scenario 1 and the data model name the deliverable `results_composition_only.json`, but T007 and the metrics schema emit `data/results/composition_only.json`. The acceptance scenario's literal verification will fail on the filename; either the task or the spec/data-model must be reconciled so the covered deliverable matches the named artifact.

The spec's edge case 'composition-only and structure-aware models yield identical performance (ΔR² ≈ 0), contradicting the hypothesis' has no corresponding task, test, or documented-analysis step anywhere in tasks.md. Even under the gated scope, T010's extension path should specify how a ΔR² ≈ 0 outcome is reported (e.g., in comparison_summary.csv / research.md), so this edge case has a coverage home.

US-2 scenario 2 (per-crystal-system isolation of error metrics and the ΔR² for hardness for a specific system, e.g. monoclinic) is only partially covered: T010's extension path names `results_structure_aware.json` and `comparison_summary.csv` but no task produces a per-system ΔR² breakdown. Add it to T010's extension clause (or T013's limitation text) so the scenario has a matcher if the CIF source is restored.
